title: Butler Mobile Launches New Wireless Service That Supports Butler University Programs
summary_en: Bulldog Nation shows up everywhere, from the student section at Hinkle Fieldhouse to alumni and employees who carry Butler with them long after graduation. Now, Butler University is introducing a new wireless service built for that community. Butler Mobile launches today through a partnership between Collegiate Mobile, Butler University Athletics, and sports marketing leader Playfly…
author: Katie Palmer Wharton '14
